name: The Scarlet Letter
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: The Scarlet Letter was written by Nathaniel Hawthorne, first published in 1850.
Hester Prynne is publicly shamed and forced to wear a scarlet "A" in Puritan Boston -- a close examination of guilt, hypocrisy, and social punishment.
Discussion prompt: Sin & Judgment is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
